question: Sangeet Natak Akademi award winner Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam was an exponent of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kuchipudi dance originated in Andhra Pradesh__.
 
• It is one of the major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• The other Indian classical dance forms are Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
